heroSubtitle: Tyler Wallace, Ph.D. speaks on AI in rural and community healthcare. Keynotes, conference sessions, webinars, and hands-on workshops for hospitals, FQHCs, physician groups, and state associations.

intro.title: Practical talks,
paragraphs: Every talk is practical. The time goes to what a hospital or clinic can do with AI now, with real examples from the ambient AI, analytics, and training work Scale Street does every week.
People leave with tangible action items.
